name: Standing Side Leg Lift
description: Strengthens the outer hip for balance: holding a wall, lift one straight leg out to the side and lower it slowly.

source.title: NHS: strength exercises (sideways leg lift)
source.note: Stick-figure approximation; the NHS version uses a chair for support.

setup: Stand tall beside a wall with one hand on it for support.
cues: Keep your back and hips straight; don't lean away.
Lift only as far as is comfortable.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Lift out to the side
keyframes.cue: Raise your left leg out to the side.
